threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver’s yelling out stops—everyone else seems to know them by heart.
Last week on the 59, a couple argued over who knew more about obscure 90s hip hop—till the driver joined in with a verse. Strange camaraderie.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a group of kids setting up a makeshift soccer game in the alley, cheering louder than any match at the Olympic Stadium.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you grab a fresh currywurst from a stand while waiting for your U-Bahn in the middle of the night. It’s a late-night tradition!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re from here if they roll their eyes at BART delays but still somehow get off at Civic Center for a burrito.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy on the 31 begging for change while solving a Rubik's Cube, finished it at the stop. Didn't even look up. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the plazas, but it's the little craft shops on Carrer de Verdi that give it soul. Miss those, and you miss us.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still rely on Google Maps for short walks; locals just navigate by the nearest bar or bakery.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Tube is the quickest way to get anywhere, but the bus routes are a maze of shortcuts only locals know.
Last night on the 35, a guy serenaded the entire bus with 'Wonderwall'—best part of my week. Everyone was just vibing, even the driver.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted a guy selling homemade falafel on the corner of Kottbusser Damm—while a street artist painted a mural next to him. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a club in a converted swimming pool, where the DJ spins while you float in the shallow end. It’s bizarre but so real!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they instinctively dodge the BART delays and still manage to find a taco truck in less than five minutes.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy serenade the bus stop this morning while waiting for the 71. Even the pigeons were bobbing along to his tune.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals are nocturnal. While we love our festas, most of us prefer a quiet evening, especially in the llaços de Gràcia.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: Their sandals with socks and overzealous map consultations at every corner give them away. Locals just rely on instincts and the occasional Google search.
